game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Ivy Tower, an ivy-covered tower: the spirit seeker must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of carved tiles while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ivy Tower: an ivy-covered tower
core_gameplay_loop: In Ivy Tower, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of carved tiles while keeping the order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about clean_list to power up the spirit seeker and open the sealed archway.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ivy Tower'.
